subject: Regional demo + security reviewers — finalizing timezone windows
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Hendrix <emma.hendrix@horizonhealth.com>, Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@acme-eu.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Regional demo + security reviewers — coordinating windows

Hi Emma / Sven / Aisha —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Dedicated. We want to run a 45–60 minute demo focused on: deployment topology (VPC/private control plane), data handling (KMS/HSM options), and the security checklist your DPO/infosec reviewers expect for a Private deployment.

To avoid repeated back-and-forth across timezones, below are a few candidate slots that try to respect local working hours for US / EU / APAC reviewers. Please indicate which slot(s) work for you and any attendees we should include. Note: we called out DST explicitly because some internal folks are traveling next week and local offsets change depending on region.

Candidate slots (all in local times and UTC):
- Option A: Wed Jun 2, 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET / 17:00–18:00 BST (16:00–17:00 UTC) — good for US daytime, late EU
- Option B: Wed Jun 2, 14:00–15:00 CEST / 08:00–09:00 ET / 05:00–06:00 PT (12:00–13:00 UTC) — EU-friendly, early US
- Option C: Thu Jun 3, 10:00–11:00 SGT / 03:00–04:00 PT / 06:00–07:00 ET (02:00–03:00 UTC) — APAC-friendly, may be early for US

What we need from you:
1) Confirm which slot(s) work for Horizon Health and whether Sven (EU DPO) can join for the EU-focused segment and Aisha (APAC security lead) for the APAC segment.
2) If any additional evidence is required ahead of time, call it out (SOC 2, architecture diagram, data flow). I attached a short SOC2 snapshot and our dedicated deployment checklist for quick review.

We’ll keep the demo to 45 minutes and then keep 15 minutes afterwards for DPO-level Q&A if needed.

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot.pdf (pdf), redwood-dedicated-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Emma Hendrix <emma.hendrix@horizonhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Security <security@horizonhealth.com>, Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@acme-eu.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T17:40:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Regional demo + security reviewers — coordinating windows

Hi Laura —

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick notes from our side:
- Sven (EU DPO) confirms he can join a European-windowed session on Wed Jun 2 between 13:00–15:00 CEST (that maps to your Option B window). He asked that we keep the architecture diagram handy and be explicit about key management and audit logs.
- Aisha (APAC security) is currently on site in Singapore the week of Jun 7 but can make an early APAC-friendly session if you prefer the week of Jun 3; she suggested Thu Jun 3 morning SGT.
- Preference: If possible, we’d like a split approach — core demo that’s friendly for EU/US, then a short APAC-focused follow-up for the APAC reviewers so they aren’t forced into a 03:00 UTC slot.

Can you propose a final schedule (one demo + optional APAC follow-up), and include a calendar invite with the meeting segmentation so teams know when to join/leave?

Emma Hendrix
Director, Product — Horizon Health
emma.hendrix@horizonhealth.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Hendrix <emma.hendrix@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@acme-eu.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T22:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Regional demo + security reviewers — coordinating windows

Emma / team —

Appreciate the clarity. Proposed plan based on availability:
- Primary demo (45m): Wed Jun 2, 13:00–13:45 CEST (12:00–12:45 UTC) — covers the main product walkthrough, deployment topology, KMS/HSM choices and audit/logging. Target attendees: Laura, Marcus (ops), Vivek (security), Sven (DPO), Emma.
- APAC follow-up (30m targeted at infosec): Thu Jun 3, 10:00–10:30 SGT (02:00–02:30 UTC) — focused on network diagrams, private deployment handoff, and on-prem footprint options. Target attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Mina.

Notes about DST / offsets: EU and UK are on CEST/BST; US participants should see the correct converted times in the calendar invite. We will add explicit local-time ranges in the invite subject line to avoid confusion. If any attendee is traveling across timezones the week of, let us know and we’ll add a second timing option.

I attached the calendar-invite.ics to this message and included a link to the demo playbook in Drive. I also added a short agenda so Sven can quickly jump to the KMS/audit section.

Forwarding the proposed calendar blocks below for quick copy into corporate calendars.

---- Forwarded calendar snippet ----
Primary Demo — Wed Jun 2
13:00–13:45 CEST / 12:00–12:45 UTC / 08:00–08:45 EDT / 05:00–05:45 PDT

APAC Follow-up — Thu Jun 3
10:00–10:30 SGT / 02:00–02:30 UTC / 19:00–19:30 PDT (Jun 2)

---- end snippet ----

If that looks good I’ll send the calendar invites and include the short pre-read (SOC2 snapshot) for the DPOs.

Thanks —
Laura

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Regional demo + security reviewers — coordinating windows

Confirmed. I’ve accepted and will join the APAC follow-up on Thu Jun 3 at 10:00 SGT. Marcus will lead the KMS section for the primary demo and I’ll handle network/topology for the APAC call. I uploaded a short network diagram to the Drive folder.

-Mina
